usageNotes: Use this to update metadata (comment, expiry, enabled state) on an existing API token, or to rotate the token secret without changing its permissions by setting regenerate=true. The token secret is only returned in the response when regenerate=true — store it immediately, as PDM will not surface it again. A user may update their own tokens without Access.Modify; that privilege is only required to modify tokens belonging to other users.

examples.summary: Rotate the secret for an automation token while keeping its current permissions

tips: Setting regenerate=true invalidates the old secret immediately; update any services using the token before or right after the call.
Use the digest param to guard against concurrent modifications when multiple admins may update the same token.
To clear the comment or expire fields, include them in the delete array rather than setting them to empty strings.
Disabling a token (enable=false) is a safe way to temporarily block access without losing the token configuration.
